declarations.description:
A round knob: drag the handle around the dial, or use the keys, to pick an angle or a value.

In `angle` mode (the default) the dial is a full circle and the value is a direction: `0` at the top, growing
clockwise up to `max` (360 by default), where it comes round to `min` again. A line from the centre points at the
handle. The arrow keys wrap past either end.

In `arc` mode the dial is an open arc, with the gap at the bottom, and `min`–`max` run along it from its left end
to its right end, like a thermostat, a volume or a gain knob. The arc fills up to the handle, a press in the gap
picks the nearer end, and the keys stop at the ends. How far the arc reaches is CSS:
`--c2-angle-slider__arc--sweep` (270 degrees by default).

A press anywhere on the dial moves the handle there and keeps following the pointer until it is released. The
handle is a `slider`: Right and Up add a `step`, Left and Down take one off, Page Up and Page Down move a tenth of
the range, Home and End go to `min` and `max`. The value shows in the middle, formatted by `formatValue` (an angle
shows with a degree sign); hide it with `--c2-angle-slider__value--display: none` or put your own content in the
default slot.

It is a form control: under a `name` the form receives the value, and it takes part in `c2-form-field`.
declarations.name: AngleSlider

cssProperties.description: Width and height of the dial.
cssProperties.name: --c2-angle-slider--size

cssProperties.description: How far the arc of `arc` mode reaches, in degrees (up to 360), centred on the top.
cssProperties.name: --c2-angle-slider__arc--sweep

cssProperties.description: The filled part of the arc in `arc` mode.
cssProperties.name: --c2-angle-slider__fill--color

cssProperties.description: The ring while an enclosing `c2-form-field` shows an error.
cssProperties.name: --c2-angle-slider__track__error--color

cssProperties.description: Thickness of the line from the centre to the handle in `angle` mode.
cssProperties.name: --c2-angle-slider__needle--width

cssProperties.description: `none` hides the value in the middle.
cssProperties.name: --c2-angle-slider__value--display

cssParts.description: The round control: the ring, the needle, the handle and the value.
cssParts.name: dial

cssParts.description: The ring the handle runs along.
cssParts.name: track

cssParts.description: In `arc` mode, the part of the ring from the start of the arc to the handle.
cssParts.name: fill

cssParts.description: In `angle` mode, the line from the centre to the handle.
cssParts.name: needle

cssParts.description: The handle, which is the focusable `slider`.
cssParts.name: thumb

cssParts.description: The value shown in the middle.
cssParts.name: value

slots.description: Replaces the value shown in the middle of the dial (an icon, a value with its own markup). Decorative: the handle still reads the value.

members.name: mode
members.description: `angle` for a direction on a full circle, `arc` for a value along an open arc.

members.name: value
members.description: The current value, kept between `min` and `max` and snapped to `step`. In `angle` mode `max` comes round to `min`.

members.name: min
members.description: The value at the top of the dial (`angle` mode) or at the start of the arc (`arc` mode).

members.name: max
members.description: The value a full turn reaches (`angle` mode), or at the end of the arc (`arc` mode).

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name: the form receives the value.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Turns the slider off; as for a disabled form control, the value is not submitted.

members.name: label
members.description: The accessible name of the slider. Inside a `c2-form-field`, the field's label names it.

members.name: formatValue
members.description: Formats the value for the middle of the dial and for assistive technology, e.g. `(v) => \`${v} °C\``. Property only.

members.name: drag
members.description: The pointer a press on the dial captured, and the value it started from.

members.name: fraction
members.description: Position of the value along the dial, `0` at `min` and `1` at `max`.

members.name: sanitize
members.description: Clamps a value into range and snaps it to `step`; in `angle` mode a full turn comes round to `min`.

members.name: sweep
members.description: The sweep of the arc in degrees, read from the CSS variable that also draws it.

members.name: valueAt
members.description: The value under a pointer, from its direction seen from the centre of the dial.

members.name: choose
members.description: Sets the value as the user's: fires `input`, and `change` when `commit`. Returns whether it changed.

events.name: input
events.description: Fired while the user changes the value, at every step of a drag or a key press. Read `value`.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired when the user commits a value: the pointer is released, or a key changed it. Not fired for programmatic changes.
